main_text.p: clivis, inde acclivis anni; solstitium in-qvam, divergentis, & brumam conver-gentis Solis. Posterius factum intelli-go, ut הקופת[?]----etiam brumæ commu-nicaretur. Favit mihi luculenter ille tuus Eliezer. Etenim si Tecupha demum Brumæ admoneret Hebræos intercala-tionis; si, inqvam dies 19 Tebeth inci-dens in Brumam potuit (nisi qvid aliud accideret annum ducere communem) vides profecto Nisani proximi diem 22 sic tunc debuisse repræsentare æqvino-ctium Vernum (Solis Apogæo finem A-rietis nondum egresso) ut ne momento qvidem posterior sentiretur: ac proin toto ante æqvinoctium octiduo Pascha-tis ritum fuisse legitimum Luculentus est iste locus Eliezeris, atqve auro supra mi-hi carus, qvi tantum jam temporis hoc ipsum testimonium unde comparandum anhelavi. Eliezerum ergo per eruditio-nem tuam istam ut edas rogo, aut si edi-tus est, ubinam, & qvanti præstat, indi-ces.
Hic si frustra sum, alterum meum erit

page.notes: The Hebrew word after "ut" (הקופת) is only roughly legible at this scan resolution; marked [?]. The Greek catchword is right-aligned below the last line and is given only in bottom_margin. Italic "ces." and the heavier "Hic si frustra sum" line are set in a different type and may be emphasised rather than italic; kept as printed.
